description: Least-privilege capability for the main window. It may call the app's own Rust commands, use core APIs (events/window), and open external URLs via the shell. Broad http/fs/store/dialog/notification/updater/autostart grants are intentionally NOT present: those plugins are driven from the Rust side, not the webview, so exposing their commands to (potentially compromised) web content is unnecessary attack surface. (Production-readiness defect #9.)
